correctness.rationale: Unital images are independent square-zero elements. For odd fields A_(r+1)=A_r⊕xA_r gives the exact annihilator-weighted recursion. A3 square-zero multiplication-rank classes 0,1,2,4 have counts 1,q−1,q(q³−1),3(q−1)q³; substituting yields S4. Cotangent invertibility forces monomial linear matrices; char2 Frobenius gives unrestricted radical choices. Independent direct enumeration confirmed S3(3)=243 and S3(5)=2125. Finite tests corroborate, not prove, field-uniform identities.

final_claim: Odd-q tensor powers of dual numbers have |End A_r|=S_r^r, with S4=q^7(q^3+5q-5); |Aut A_r|=r!(q-1)^r q^(r(2^(r-1)-1)); rank-four density ~24q^-8. In characteristic two |End|=q^(r(2^r-1)) and density tends to one for r<=4.
